status: PROPOSED scaffold; freeze at Gate 2 review before any Gate 3 fit
approach: Approach 1: regularized linear model (ridge) on log1p(loss)
hypothesis: September found weak, mostly additive marginal signals. A penalized linear model on the log scale should beat both constant predictors on held-out MAE, but will miss nonlinear effects and interactions between fields.

preprocessing.unseen_or_missing_category: rare column if the field has one, otherwise all zeros
preprocessing.continuous: StandardScaler fit on the fit rows
preprocessing.correlated_pairs: cont11/cont12 and cont1/cont9 retained; L2 penalty shares weight
preprocessing.fit_scope: refit inside every CV fit portion and for the final training refit

target.inverse: expm1(clip(z, log1p(min fit loss), log1p(max fit loss)))
target.non_finite_output: raise error; log the run as failed; never drop or fill predictions

search_space.complexity_order: larger alpha = stronger penalty = simpler model

evaluation.selection_metric: pooled out-of-fold MAE in original loss units
evaluation.also_report: each fold's MAE and claim count, mean and sample sd, fold-matched mean/median constants
evaluation.tie_rule: within 1 loss unit of the best pooled MAE counts as tied; pick the larger alpha
evaluation.edge_rule: if the best alpha is at either end of the grid, record it; extending needs a team amendment
evaluation.final_refit: refit the selected alpha on all 141,238 training claims
evaluation.validation_release: the single selected candidate only, scored once with the shared evaluator
